item.description: SPARKS, MD. — A rare Tennessee redware jar, attributed to C.A. Haun Pottery, Greene County, having crosshatched copper slip, outperformed its $15/25,000 estimate to attain $108,000, including buyer’s premium, at Crocker Farm’s winter auction of the Carole Wahler collection that ran January 21-31. item.title: Clars Starts The New Year Strong With Gallery Auction
item.description: OAKLAND, CALIF. — Furniture, decorative arts, fine art, jewelry and Asian art made up the 645 lots of Clars Auctions’ January Gallery Auction, which was conducted on the 23rd. While a sale total was not disclosed, press representative Talesa Eugenio shared that the sell-through rate was 83 percent.
